emails/task-assignment/body.html.pug:
doctype html
html
  head
    meta(charset='utf-8')
    style.
      body {
        white-space: pre-line;
      }
  body
    h1 Task Assigned

    p Hello #{firstName},

    p You have been assigned a new task by #{requesterName}.

    p
      strong Task:
      |  #{taskTitle}
    if taskDescription
      p
        strong Description:
        |  #{taskDescription}
    if taskIsUrgent
      p
        strong URGENT

    p
      a(href=taskLink) View Task

    p Please review the task details and take appropriate action.
